canonical_program:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (passable? r c v) (not (= v 5)))
    (define seen (make-hash))
    (define comps (list))
    (for ([p (in-list (grid-positions g))])
      (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)))
        (when (and (not (hash-has-key? seen p)) (passable? r c (at g r c)))
          (let ((comp (connected-region g r c passable?)))
            (for ([q (in-list comp)]) (hash-set! seen q #t))
            (set! comps (cons comp comps))))))
    (for/fold ([out (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g) (lambda (r c) (if (= (at g r c) 5) 5 0)))]) ([comp comps])
      (let* ((counts (map (lambda (color) (list color (count-where (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) color)) comp))) (list 2 3 4)))
             (best (first (sort counts (lambda (a b) (if (= (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b)) (> (second a) (second b))))))))
        (if (= (second best) 0)
            out
            (paint-cells out comp (first best)))))))

rival_description: Fill each marked non-wall region with its smallest present marker color, ignoring marker counts.
rival_construction: Reuse canonical compartment traversal; replace only the majority-vote comparator with smallest-present-color ordering.

authored_query.construction: Keep walls, moat and all other compartments from demo 0. Clear the first marked region and place one color-2 marker followed by two color-4 markers in row-major order.

scope: One rival, three generated seed-0 demonstrations, and one authored validator-lawful mixed-marker query. No generated-default-query failure or population frequency is claimed.
proposed_mitigation: Teach strict-majority comparisons using mixed marker colors within a compartment, including a smaller-valued minority; retain matched minority/majority contrasts in lessons.
